CONSTANTS.V: Set of values that may be broadcast

receivep.description: Mapping from each process to the value it has received from the broadcaster (or empty string)
receivep.init: If broadcaster ∈ Correct, all processes receive the same chosen value; otherwise unconstrained

delivered.description: Delivered value of each correct process, or empty string if undecided
delivered.init: All correct processes initially map to empty string

echoRcvd.description: echoRcvd[p][v] is the set of processes whose ECHO(v) has been received by p
echoRcvd.init: Initially empty for all p and v

voteRcvd.description: voteRcvd[p][v] is the set of processes whose VOTE(v) has been received by p
voteRcvd.init: Initially empty for all p and v

readyRcvd.description: readyRcvd[p][v] is the set of processes whose READY(v) has been received by p
readyRcvd.init: Initially empty for all p and v

Actions.name: SendReady(self)
condition: ∃ v ∈ V : |echoRcvd[self][v] \ {broadcaster}| ≥ ⌈(N + F - 1)/2⌉ OR |voteRcvd[self][v] \ {broadcaster}| ≥ ⌈(N + F - 1)/2⌉ OR |readyRcvd[self][v]| ≥ F + 1

Actions.name: ByzantineEcho(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ v ∈ V : echoRcvd[d][v] := echoRcvd[d][v] ∪ {self}

Actions.name: ByzantineVote(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ v ∈ V : voteRcvd[d][v] := voteRcvd[d][v] ∪ {self}

Actions.name: ByzantineReady(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ v ∈ V : readyRcvd[d][v] := readyRcvd[d][v] ∪ {self}

Actions.name: Next
effect: (∃ self ∈ Correct : SendEcho(self) OR SendVote(self) OR SendReady(self) OR OptCommit(self) OR StepCommit(self))
(∃ self ∈ Faulty : ByzantineEcho(self) OR ByzantineVote(self) OR ByzantineReady(self))
Actions.description: Global step relation: some correct process executes one of its enabled actions, or some faulty process acts.

Actions.name: Spec
effect: ∀ self ∈ Correct : WF_vars(SendEcho(self) OR SendVote(self) OR SendReady(self) OR OptCommit(self) OR StepCommit(self))
Actions.description: Full system spec: initial condition, step relation, and weak fairness for correct-process actions.

Invariants.name: TypeInv
Invariants.description: All variables remain within their declared types

Invariants.name: Agreement
Invariants.description: No two correct processes decide different values

Properties.name: Totality
Properties.description: If some correct process decides, eventually all correct processes decide
Properties.spec_instance: (∃ i ∈ Correct : delivered[i] ≠ "") ~> (∀ i ∈ Correct : delivered[i] ≠ "")

Properties.name: Validity
Properties.description: If the broadcaster is correct, all correct processes eventually decide its value

llm_hint.echoRcvd: echoRcvd[p][v] abstracts the set of senders whose ECHO(v) messages have been received by p
llm_hint.voteRcvd: voteRcvd[p][v] abstracts the set of senders whose VOTE(v) messages have been received by p
llm_hint.readyRcvd: readyRcvd[p][v] abstracts the set of senders whose READY(v) messages have been received by p
llm_hint.Byzantine_model: Faulty processes may arbitrarily inject ECHO, VOTE, or READY messages for any value to any correct process
llm_hint.no_message_queue: Explicit message queues are abstracted away in favor of set-based reception state
llm_hint.non_broadcaster_count: Conditions like |echoRcvd[self][v] \ {broadcaster}| count messages from non-broadcaster parties as per pseudocode
llm_hint.N_and_F: N = Cardinality(Correct ∪ Faulty), F = Cardinality(Faulty); these are derived, not constants
